descriptor: Bakery box subscription asking how it went

voice.summary: A baker asking how the box went over a quick chat: friendly, informal and quick. The form promises about 30 seconds and keeps its promise.
dos: Say how long the form takes

boilerplate: Crumb & Co. Bakery Box is a bakery subscription that delivers boxes of fresh bread and pastries, and invites customers to rate each box in about 30 seconds.

microcopy.success: Thanks. Your feedback is in the oven
microcopy.error: That didn't send. Please try once more
microcopy.empty: No rating yet. Tap a star

logo.note: A paper bag stands for the bakery box in hand.
